lines.t: Over which you have painted to hide the heart's true nature
For those who embrace that which they keep hidden
And that they may bring it forward shall be set free
Yet those who remain clothed before me
May I clothe you in these new robes
Naked, having formed you in that secret place
Naked, is it then too much to ask of my beloved
To return to me in the same manner
Little children return to me as a child
Run to me as an innocent child would come
Cast off all these robes sewn in sin
See them for what they are
Beloved, you have made them and put them on
I have stripped you naked and washed you
Clinging to that which is passed away
All your efforts by which you attempt to justify yourselves
All your efforts to appear clean
Only serve to cover you in shame
Cease from seeking after human praise
Cease from seeking out human approval
Let me fill your heart with joy and peace
And all these bruises will vanish from sight
I accept your bruises and all that you are
What was it I withheld in my passion?
Name it, if you are able
I was destroyed because of my love for you
I gave up everything because of my love for you

I love you, I love you, and by this alone must you also be destroyed, and because of this alone must you also give up everything, love, my love, when you partake of me fully then, and only then shall you be purged, be destroyed in my love, cry, wail,
be undone withhold no more my love is a light which shines in a dark place
warmth which brings peace and healing to those whose hearts have grown cold affection in its
purest form unconditional therefore come to me beloved that our hearts may be satisfied
For all those who sincerely long for me
And all those who obey my voice
And all those who love me
Shall know the depths of my mercy
